# AuthCost

> Auth and identity list prices (base + MAU/MRU + SSO), 34 plan rows, 34 verified, 13 vendors, checked 2026-11-07.

## Methodology
Prices from each vendor's own pricing page only. Verified rows were read on the date shown. We never invent a price. Details: http://localhost:4190/methodology

## Data (CC BY 4.0 — attribute "AuthCost" + link http://localhost:4190/)
- [Plans JSON](http://localhost:4190/api/plans.json)
- [Plans CSV](http://localhost:4190/api/plans.csv)
- [Changes JSON](http://localhost:4190/api/changes.json)
- [Full dump](http://localhost:4190/llms-full.txt)

## Assumptions
- SSO results for Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (billed per SSO user) assume 200 SSO users per connection; sensitivity at 1000 and 2000: http://localhost:4190/methodology#sso-users
- B2B: SSO results assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection; org fees/caps applied (Clerk B2B add-on, Auth0 org caps, Descope/Kinde per-tenant fees): http://localhost:4190/methodology#b2b-orgs
- Headline: At 100k users, Clerk Pro lists $1,025/mo; WorkOS AuthKit, the cheapest verified plan that includes MFA at that size, lists $0 ($12,300/yr less).
